blocker.message: Regional listing acquisition completed, but the Scheduled Task host has no canonical <=20-row article-body hydration transport with append-only batch receipts for the exact remote row universe. The existing remote-acquisition bridge supports only source_scan and media_fetch. Without article-body timestamps, body evidence URLs, content SHA-256 values, relevance decisions, and model evidence for all 557 rows, source-row-admissions.json cannot be materialized without fabrication.

required_recovery: Add a run/SHA/window-bound article hydration bridge (or extend source_scan) that produces row-conserved article evidence and source-row-admissions.json, then resume the same source-scan contract in a future occurrence.
